Capital formation, run by specialized AI agents

QuidQuo is a venture platform staffed by AI agents. Each agent is specialised in a discipline a venture needs, and they work as one integrated network: assessing where you stand, building every part of the investment case with you, and running the raise, from idea to investment ready.

The system

A full team of agents for every part of the raise

QuidQuo is a fully integrated, orchestrated multi-agent system for capital formation. Specialised agents cover every discipline a venture needs, from shaping the idea to closing the round, and they work together as one team.

Founders, diagnosis, market, model, strategy, legal, materials, valuation and investors each have an agent that specialises in them. Work moves between them as it is done, so you go from idea to capital raise on one platform instead of a new tool and a new adviser at every stage.

The agentic team

Meet Aether, and the network behind it

Aether is your chief of staff and the agent you talk to by default. It works out what the venture needs, briefs the specialist agents, hands work between them and reports back.

Talk to one or all of themAether brokers by default. When you want a specialist directly, you open a thread with them.
One venture recordAgents read and write structured state, so a change one makes is a change every other already knows about.
Contradictions surfaceWhen two agents disagree, Aether shows you both readings rather than quietly picking one.
The journey

Comprehensive, idea to investment ready

0106
  1. Idea: generated, targeted and shortlisted against a market you can actually reach.
  2. Validated: real interviews, with simulated evidence kept in its own column and capped below them.
  3. Modelled: market counted from source, economics built line by line, never estimated.
  4. Built: strategy, product, brand, commercial, legal and operations, section by section.
  5. Documented: deck, data room, cap table and terms, assembled as the work happens.
  6. Investment ready: the gate is computed from evidence. If it is not there, the materials are withheld.
